name: linkversity
description: Discover Linkversity collections, access your saved learning resources, and generate study plans from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Search public Linkversity collections by topic, open the links inside a collection, connect your own Linkversity account to retrieve your saved collections, and turn a collection into a personalized study plan sequenced for your experience level and available time. Every result links back to the original resource on Linkversity. The plugin only reads your data - it never changes your collections.
defaultPrompt: Find public Linkversity collections about machine learning
Turn this Linkversity collection into a study plan for a beginner with 3 hours a week
